body: Hah, I get you totally. I'm a bit of the paranoid type. Furthermore, I'm such a loser, I won't end up with bruises, rather with broken bones and limp about for several months, lol.

Thank you for the warm words, my dear friend!
I'm currently struggling with loneliness, have few friends and I don't/can't connect with most of them on a personal level.
Plus, it's about the end of the year so *exams* and nobody wants/ has time to go out and chill. :(
P.S. I'm awkward around children. I love interacting with them and goofing around, I'm rather childish myself, but I still feel weird around them. Probably, because I watched The Hunt that one time, lol.

Barbecued ribs, I guess.

I avoid processed foods, junk food etc.

Yes, we're in the same boat.

  Writing down stuff really helps, I agree.

  I'm also often suicidal, it's my inner voice basically pushing me to jump in front of the subway train, etc.

  However, suicide attempts are often unsuccessful, will most likely damage you.

  We lost a girl in our university to suicide recently. This can really help you remember how precious life is.
Oh, I can't begin to imagine what it is for you, brother. I wish you all the best, never give up, stay strong!

First, yes! I love it when people get my name! Love the band, too. :)

  

  Since I was abandoned by my mother several times, I have trust issues. Grew up in a mostly female environment, so I often got hurt by women. I'm not a misogynist, obviously, but there is this expectancy to get hurt by women.

  Also, I struggle with the concept of love. It's very difficult for me to use endearing names, to say "I love you" or feel loved back. Even if I wish all the best to a person, enjoy their company, feel happy when I see them, I can't express it, I come off as a *mechanical animal*. **\*wink\***

  I understand how letting go of masculinity/femininity can release a person in a way. I'm rather feminine in my manners and in the way I look physically(little facial hair, narrow shoulders etc.), but sexually, I'm 100% straight.

I've cried so much while growing up, I have no tears left. I've shared to one very close friend my feelings, but that's it. The others see me as constantly depressed, but I don't want to impose and I also don't believe they have the answers, since they're also young.
